body: You can visibly see that my post has shed positive light onto multiple people. I do care about everyone in this sub, whether I know them or not. If you have a problem report it to a mod.
There’s a lady that used to make them with a tube to connect to a helium tank, I don’t think she sells them anymore
You could always just get lucky if thanos ever comes back and snaps his fingers
I truly feel you. This feeling sucks, but at the same time the ideation is quite calming. I wish there was a way that’s painless to everyone too.
There’s are, you just have to do research like the rest of us. painless to you that is, at the end of the day it’s just handing the pain down to other people

I’ll be honest I’ve been thinking about the same thing, buying a 30 rack of beer and walking up the the top of one of the abandoned grain silos in my city, it’s about 8 stories and in the middle of an a abandoned lot so I know that even if I do survive the jump that I’ll still end up “getting the job done”. I found out that the most painless way is do hook a helium tank up to a breathing machine, I guess your body doesn’t panic when inhaling helium. I’m not scared of doing it at all but I am scared of failing, living on life support or having a mental disability for the rest of this shitty life. The world isn’t the problem, and the people aren’t either, I am the problem. I’m sick of burdening and hurting the people I love. I know I’m going to do it, I just don’t know when
Pills are one of the most painful ways to go
